name: Boku Kano ~ Boku ga Kanojo o Aishita Keii ni Tsuite
original_name: ボクカノ ～僕が男の娘を愛した経緯について
source:
He came to the Ohshikouchi Estate to tutor the esteemed family's son and daughter. However, he was greeted by two young daughters only. Or rather, the son was so beautiful that his gender could be mistaken. 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE059538.html]dlsite[/url]]
